# `set_all_connected`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Connect or disconnect all equipment.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x74100 (64-bit build) |

true connects all operational equipment and false disconnects it, through the equipment dialog logic. The value MUST be an actual JSON boolean (bare or as the first array element); an integer is rejected with 106 because this handler tests the node type directly. A missing equipment dialog gives 300; a connection failure is also reported (code 201 in the source, not in its explicit error list). Event ordering and subtype-specific errors are unresolved. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay.

Side effects: Connects or closes camera, mount and auxiliary equipment connections.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_all_connected"`. [READ] |
| `params` | boolean\|array | yes | - | true to connect all, false to disconnect all: a bare boolean or an array whose first element is the boolean. Integers are rejected. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 106 | Parameter is not a JSON boolean | `expected bool param` |
| 300 | Equipment dialog object missing | `internal error` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

## Example

Request, request - Example request (values invented):

```json
{"id":50,"method":"set_all_connected","params":true}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_all_connected","result":0,"code":0,"id":50}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_all_connected","error":"expected bool param","code":106,"id":51}
```
